prompt:
Create one photorealistic jewelry photograph.

IDENTITY
Exact pendant name: "محمد". Arabic, right-to-left reading. This text forms the jewelry, not a caption.
Classic Arabic lettering, preserving the approved shaped glyphs. One upright name; no second name or two-name connector.

CONSTRUCTION
Experimental folded-letter recipe: the lettering itself is a continuous metal ribbon with shallow alternating folded planes across broad strokes. Preserve readable glyph contours and connected metal through each crease. No separate folded carrier, cracks, cut letters or surrounding frame. Lettering itself has continuous shallow alternating folded planes; no separate folded carrier. The silhouette and original eyelets remain fixed.
Exactly two integral body eyelets at the designated attachment locations. Each existing eyelet receives one separate closed connecting ring, and each connecting ring receives the first cable-chain link. The connecting rings and alternating chain links remain separate interlocking parts. Continue the chain beyond the photographic frame; do not show loose cut ends beside the pendant.
@geometry defines the exact rigid body: glyph contours, supports and integral eyelets. Render this body with the specified separate connecting hardware and chain. Do not add or relocate body holes.

CUSTOMER SELECTIONS
White gold appearance, clean polished finish. Coherent reflections, visible edge thickness and believable edge bevels. No assumed karat or invented material certificate.
Stone-free metal. No gemstones, pavé, prongs, bezels or empty stone seats.
Nominal selected size label: 32 mm. Preserve the approved reference proportions. Do not print measurement labels or invent other dimensions.
Cable chain: alternating oval links. One necklace attached at its specified body attachment points.
No additional personalization.

PHOTOGRAPHY
Near-front catalog photograph on matte ivory. One large soft source with gentle fill and neutral white balance. Entire pendant and both attachment junctions visible, with sufficient depth of field to inspect the construction.

PRESERVE
Preserve the core Muhammad lettering, its reading order, letter counters, approved support contacts and the two designated body attachment points. Preserve continuous shallow folded-letter planes. Preserve intentional letter counters, openwork and hardware apertures. All visible parts have plausible support. No loose chain ends beside an attachment, impossible intersections, extra holes, missing letters, captions, logos or sparkle graphics.
